device.description: 12-bit 8-channel simultaneous-sampling bipolar-input SAR ADC (650 kSPS parallel) with parallel and serial interfaces
device.note: ads8528.pdf (SBAS543C, ADS8528/ADS8548/ADS8568) p.4-5 pin configurations (RGC VQFN-64, PM LQFP-64), p.6-8 pin functions, p.9 recommended operating conditions (DVDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.16 serial interface timing (Figure 1 p.18), p.29-30 CONVST_x and BUSY/INT, p.33 serial interface, p.34 Table 3 output data format and software mode, p.35 Figure 40 register update, p.39-41 CONFIG register

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.note: p.39-41 Figure 44: CONFIG, default 000003FFh; bits 17-16 and 12-10 not used (default 0, modeled read-only)

registers.name: MODE
registers.note: internal: follows the HW/SW pin (1 = software mode; CONFIG can only be changed in software mode, p.39)

commands.name: CONFIG update + read-out (C31 = 1, C30 = 1)
commands.note: p.34-35: the first 32 SDI bits of a frame carry C[31:0]; the update takes effect at the 32nd SCLK falling edge when WRITE_EN (C31) = 1; p.39 READ_EN: CONFIG is output on SDO_A with the next accesses, READ_EN then resets to 0

commands.name: CONFIG update (C31 = 1)
commands.note: p.34-35, p.39: C31 = 0 leaves CONFIG unchanged (SDI may be held low)

pages: p.4-5 (pin configurations RGC/PM, same numbering), p.6-8 (pin functions), p.9 (DVDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.16 (serial timing: tCONV 1.33 us max, tDMSB 12 ns, tPDDO 17 ns, tDTRI 10 ns; data changes and SDI is latched on SCLK falling edges), p.18 (Figure 1: SCLK idles high, MSB valid after FS falls), p.29-30 (CONVST_x, BUSY/INT), p.33 (serial interface, SDO_A order), p.34 (Table 3 twos complement with sign extension; software mode), p.35 (Figure 40 CONFIG updates), p.39-41 (CONFIG register, default 000003FFh)
notModeled: analog side: +/-4 VREF / +/-2 VREF bipolar inputs (RANGE pin or RANGE_x bits), HVDD/HVSS, internal reference, REFDAC (C[9:0]), reference buffers and their decoupling pins; every channel gives the 0 V code (twos, 0000h)

only the serial interface (PAR/SER high) is modeled, with all eight results on SDO_A (SEL_B = SEL_CD = 0, 128 SCLKs, order A0 A1 B0 B1 C0 C1 D0 D1). The SDO_B/SDO_C/SDO_D splits (SEL_B, SEL_CD) and daisy-chain inputs DCIN_x (DCEN) are not modeled; DB13-DB15 are never driven. The parallel interface (PAR/SER low: RD/CS reads of DB[15:0] per channel, CONFIG written by two 16-bit WR accesses) is not modeled
12-bit results are sign-extended to 16 bits (Table 3); the leading 4 bits are modeled as 0, correct for the 0 V code only

each frame restarts the output at CH_A0; reading the eight results in several shorter frames (eight 16-bit, four 32-bit transfers) continues where the previous frame stopped in the device - the model restarts (all results are 0 anyway); CONVST_A resets the channel sequence

CONFIG read-out: READ_EN outputs CONFIG on SDO_A 'with the next two accesses'; the model outputs the 32-bit CONFIG once at the start of the next frame. READ_EN and WRITE_EN themselves are not stored (read back 0). Unused bits 17-16 and 12-10 are modeled read-only 0

only CONVST_A starts conversions (all CONVST_x tied together); separate channel-pair starts, sequential operation (per-pair BUSY pulses), per-pair power-down (PD_x) and the channel-pair data order with powered-down pairs are not modeled
conversion clock: internal clock time tCONV max used; external XCLK (CLKSEL), CLKOUT on RANGE/XCLK, auto-sleep (ASLEEP pin, up to 26 clocks) are not modeled

STBY (pin in hardware mode, CONFIG.STBY in software mode) power-down is not modeled; RESET aborts conversions and resets CONFIG (modeled); hardware-mode pin functions (RANGE, REFEN, REFBUFEN, STBY) are analog/power settings
BUSY/INT INT mode clears at the next read access (FS falling); BUSY/INT polarity and mode come from CONFIG C27/C26 (modeled with enable conditions)
variants: ADS8528 (12-bit), ADS8548 (14-bit), ADS8568 (16-bit) share ads8528.pdf; same pinout and CONFIG register, they differ in resolution, sign extension and conversion time (1.33 / 1.45 / 1.7 us)
